title: SIExBench finds valid automated patches can leave sensitive exposure unresolved
summary: The benchmark evaluates patches for 161 historical defects using exposure and regression checks; valid patches often did not remove the exposure. Benchmark performance does not establish remediation outcomes in live systems or show that a particular vulnerability was exploited.
ai_technology: Three large language models generated repository-level defensive patches for sensitive-information exposure defects.
